sources_considered.why: Readable contemporaneous reporting documents a restricted subscription use and the company's capacity explanation.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph following the description of peak-hour restrictions
evidence_items.explanation: The article documents third-party usage moving outside included subscription limits and quotes Anthropic's capacity explanation. This predates the forecast and concerns one provider, so it is context rather than fulfillment.

evidence_items.locator: Section Expensive frontier models have firms looking elsewhere
evidence_items.explanation: The report discusses modeled economics that depend on utilization. Lower subscription prices than API-equivalent charges do not establish provider losses on every subscription, and these later observations cannot establish April economics.

metric_scope.metric: Subscription price relative to API-equivalent usage charges

unresolved_gaps: No consistent cost basis or product-level accounts establish that every subscription was substantially subsidized.
The forecast has no deadline or closed product universe.
Individual restrictions cannot establish eventual degradation across all products.
The accessible economics reporting covers later periods and relies on modeled utilization.
